extraction.Name: Henry Young
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent recorded Jul. 1, 1921, by Bennett County Bank, Martin, So. D.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Bennett County Bank, Martin, So. Dak. for $416.85 on May 2, 1921; mortgaged to Homer B. Skeen of Cody, Nebr. for $639.20 on May 4, 1921; Bennett County Bank assigned mortgage for $438.39 to Homer B. Skeen on Dec. 6, 1922; deeded to Homer B. Skeen, Cody, Nebr. for $3000.00 on Jan. 23, 1923
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jun. 20, 1918. Land described as SE1/4 25-37-34. Wife: Viola Young. On Jan. 25, 1923, H. B. Skeen signed satisfaction of mortgage to himself dated May 4, 1921, recorded Jan. 29, 1923. On Jan. 25, 1923, H. B. Skeen signed satisfaction of mortgage to Bennett County Bank dated May 2, 1921, recorded Jan. 29, 1923. Conveyance of SE1/4 25-37-34 to Homer B. Skeen recorded Jan. 29, 1923. Document taken from records at the County Seat.
